course_name_original: TECNOLOGIA DE FABRICACION DE MATERIALES PLASTICOS

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to design, manage and operate polymer transformation processes and equipment, and determine their influence on the quality and cost of the obtained product.

assessment_rules: The minimum grade to pass each activity is 5. Laboratory practices are mandatory to pass the course; if not attended, students must take an exam demonstrating the acquired competencies. There are two evaluation paths for the ordinary call: progressive evaluation (two 40% written exams and 20% laboratory practice work/reports) or a global exam (80% theory exam and 20% lab practices). If lab practices were approved previously with a grade of 5 or higher, the student only takes the theory part. In case of not approving any activity, the student may take the pending part in the ordinary and extraordinary global exams. For the extraordinary call, evaluation is a 100% written exam.
